svg.title: Projects
svg.desc: Project list. Ledger.m: personal finance, connected to my bank through Plaid (private). Dummy Peptides: storefront for a research-peptide business I co-own (live). Imperium: agent that runs my Mac from my phone (demo). Cosmo: iOS astrology app with AI readings + subscriptions (source). StayDue: syllabus PDF in, every deadline in one calendar (beta). EasyMail: recap-first triage across Gmail and Outlook (building).
